subject: Renewal + Seat Add: billing contact verification & consolidated invoice route
messages:
From: Lara Cho <lara.cho@sentinelanalytics.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: finance@sentinelanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + upsell — PO and billing routing questions

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the renewal quote — the team is aligned to move forward with the 250k token pack and the 10 additional seats for our EU analytics team. Finance has a couple of asks before we issue a PO:

- We need invoices issued to Sentinel Analytics Ltd (UK entity) with the VAT reverse-charge line item shown.
- Do you support consolidating all seat/usage charges into a single monthly invoice (one invoice per month covering hosted + dedicated usage)?
- Please confirm the payor name on the contract so our AP can generate a PO — they typically want the invoice payee to match the payor on the PO.

I attached a draft PO header (Sentinel_PO_987654.pdf) with our internal fields. Can you confirm the routing and whether Redwood can accept our PO number on invoices? Also, legal asked whether we need to provide a W-8BEN-E or other tax form for Redwood to issue EU invoices — happy to share whatever you need.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we hope to have the PO out by next week.

Best,
Lara
Finance Operations
Sentinel Analytics


From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
To: lara.cho@sentinelanalytics.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + upsell — PO and billing routing questions

Hi Lara — thanks, and congrats on the expansion. Quick answers up front:

- We can issue a single consolidated monthly invoice that includes both hosted API usage and Dedicated capacity charges (one invoice per calendar month).
- We will include a VAT reverse-charge line per UK/EU invoicing rules; please confirm the Sentinel VAT number and billing address (I didn't see it on the PO header).
- Redwood can accept your PO number on invoices; once we have the PO we will map it to the billing entity and include it on every invoice.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa (billing) will confirm the invoice payee entity mapping and whether the invoices will be issued from Redwood EU Ltd or Redwood Inc.
2) Ben (accounts) will prepare a DocuSign envelope with the amendment that adds the 10 seats and links the PO number to the subscription; once signed we’ll start billing under the new quantity.
3) Lara — please share the Sentinel VAT number and the finalized PO file; if you prefer we can accept the PO as a PDF attached to DocuSign.

I attached our standard W-8BEN-E template and a short checklist for EU billing (Redwood_W8BEN-E-template.pdf). If you need a W-9 instead for any US entity, let me know.

We want to avoid a split-payor issue where invoices go to multiple entities — do you expect multiple legal entities paying for different parts of the subscription? If yes, we’ll set up split billing accounts (that adds a small onboarding step).

I’ll leave the payment-ops mapping to Marissa and Ben — looping them in now.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Renewals | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0192

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: lara.cho@sentinelanalytics.com, irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + upsell — PO and billing routing questions

Hi Lara — Marissa from Billing here. A few operational notes and a quick checklist so we can avoid delays:

Checklist (what we need from Sentinel to complete onboarding):
- Final signed PO (PDF) with PO number included in the header (we will record this as PO: 987654).
- Official Billing Contact name + email (we received finance@sentinelanalytics.com but need a named contact for notifications).
- VAT registration number for Sentinel Analytics Ltd (for reverse-charge).
- Confirmation whether invoices should be issued from Redwood EU Ltd (recommended) or Redwood Inc.

Billing flow options (choose one):
A) Consolidated monthly invoice (preferred): single invoice covering hosted usage + dedicated capacity, PO number present, net 30 by default (we can do net 45 on approval).
B) Split invoices by legal entity: requires separate billing accounts and a short onboarding for each payor.

We can put the consolidated invoice onto Sentinel’s AP portal (we have a vendor portal link) or send via email to the billing contact. We will also include the PO number on the invoice PDF metadata so your AP system can auto-match.

Action items:
- Lara: confirm VAT #, billing contact, and whether you want net 30 or net 45 terms. If net 45, I’ll route to finance for approval and confirm any temporary credit hold policy.
- Ben: I’ll hand off to you for DocuSign amendment setup once we have the finalized PO and entity selection.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Sentinel_PO_987654.pdf (received)
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: lara.cho@sentinelanalytics.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:07:00 +0000
Subject: Docs for signature + mapping to PO 987654

Hi Lara — Ben from Accounts. I put together the DocuSign envelope that contains:
- Amendment to the subscription (adds 10 seats, updates token pack)
- Billing routing form (invoice payee selection: Redwood EU Ltd vs Redwood Inc)
- Redirect consent (if you want invoices to go to your AP portal)

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def456
Envelope ID: ABC123def456

Notes: once you sign we will:
- Map PO 987654 to the subscription and include it on all future invoices.
- If you elect consolidated monthly invoices we’ll start issuing the combined invoice from the next billing cycle (first consolidated invoice scheduled for 2026-09-01).
- If you select net 45, please confirm and I’ll flag the account for extended payment terms; approval usually takes up to 2 business days.

If you prefer, we can attach the side-by-side sample invoice (how hosted + dedicated charges will appear) — happy to send that.

Thanks and speak soon,
Ben Carter
Accounts Receivable | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-512-555-0188
